title: MV Displaying specific sideview battler poses with js

posts.author: VeeSheeb
posts.body:
I was wondering if it's possible to specify one of a sideview battler's poses via javascript to, for instance, make battle screen cutscenes similar to Final Fantasy 6
like switching to the character's damage sprite to show them as shocked
i assume if it could be done to the player actors it could also be done to enemies that use sideview sprites via Yanfly's "Animated Sideview Enemies"?
i accept alternative methods to achieve this, if there are any

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: Yanfly's Action Sequences have commands to show any of the motions.

posts.author: VeeSheeb
posts.body: i never experimented with action sequences bc those plugins look kinda overwhelming ;w;
